# Mohit Rajput — Salesforce UI Developer

> Portfolio of Mohit Rajput, a Salesforce front-end engineer with 5+ years of experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC), OmniStudio, Experience Cloud and Marketing Cloud solutions at Wipro and Mphasis Silverline. Nine Salesforce certifications, five Trailhead superbadges, Triple Star Ranger. Open to opportunities worldwide (remote, hybrid or onsite).
